items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Yeah, Solomon was coming that door, yeah?

ctx.x: Yeah, he played way up until he died. Yeah. I read about a fellow named Duriam in a book. Did you ever hear of anybody called Duriam that played trombone? Duriam? No. Who was the trombone player with the Nola band then, other than Harrison Bond? Harrison Bond, yeah. Anybody else? No, I believe Harrison is the only one.

Yeah, Solomon was coming that door, yeah? All right. He left it open? No, he didn't open. Okay. Well, we can get it. Yeah. Well, I saw in a book about Duriam, and I never heard of anybody. I don't know that name at all. I don't know that name.
Did you ever know a fellow that played sousaphone named Booker? I know of him too, but I don't know him, Booker.
